source.name: Gnucap regression test circuits, translated to SPICE3/ngspice dialect
source.redistributionDecision: Allowed under GPL-3.0-or-later. Translated decks are modified versions of the Gnucap tests, redistributed under the same licence with the tests/MakeList notice and the full GPLv3 text; every modified deck states that it was modified, by what, and when (2026-10-11) in its header. Gnucap reference outputs (tests/==out) are redistributed verbatim.
source.mechanicalAdaptation: Deterministic, purely syntactic Gnucap-to-SPICE3 translation by benchmarks/translate/gnucap-to-spice3.ts of the 15 corpus-e fixtures ngspice rejects verbatim; originals in benchmarks/corpus/corpus-e stay byte-identical. Rules: keep the original title line verbatim; write Gnucap # comments as * comments; comment out the console-only commands .list, .width, .status/.stat and bare .options; remove Gnucap-only solver/console options (nopage, dampstrategy, trsteporder, noincmode, nobypass); write .plot as .print and drop plot ranges; comment out .print op (no SPICE3 form) and drop Gnucap-only probes from .print (raw output still holds every node voltage and source current); drop Gnucap trace options from .op/.tran; write the single-frequency .ac f as .ac lin 1 f f; write dc <function> as the bare function; parenthesise unparenthesised pwl/pulse/sin arguments; write off=1 as off; rename a duplicate instance name that Gnucap keeps as two elements and SPICE3 rejects. Fixtures needing anything else (generator sources, parameter re-assignment between analyses, bare repeat analyses, Gnucap MOS level 7) are listed under unsupportedTranslations and not approximated. Per-fixture change lists are in each circuit's translation.changes and in each deck header.

circuits.stressRationale: See the original corpus-e entry; the translation preserves topology, values, models and analyses.

changes: commented out `.list` (Gnucap `.list` only echoes the netlist to the console)
commented out `.width out=132` (Gnucap `.width` only sets the console output width)
commented out `.print op v(1) v(2) v(3) v(4) v(5) v(6) v(7) f(f2) f(f7)` (SPICE3 has no `.print op`; the raw file still holds every node voltage and source current)
`.print tran v(1) v(2) v(3) v(4) v(5) v(6) v(7) f(f2) f(f7)`: Gnucap-only probes f(f2) f(f7) dropped (no SPICE3 output-variable syntax)
`.print ac v(1) v(2) v(3) v(4) v(5) v(6) v(7) f(f2) f(f7)`: Gnucap-only probes f(f2) f(f7) dropped (no SPICE3 output-variable syntax)
commented out `.status notime` (Gnucap `.status` only prints solver statistics)

reasons: `V1 1 0 gen(1)`: Gnucap `gen()` generator source has no SPICE3 equivalent
`.param rs=50`: Gnucap bare-name parameter references in element values are not SPICE3 syntax
`.ac 0 40meg 2meg`: Gnucap start/stop/step AC sweep form has no exact SPICE3 spelling
`.param rs=.1`: Gnucap re-assigns a parameter between analyses; a SPICE3 deck has one parameter value per run

`.ac`: bare Gnucap `.ac` repeats the previous sweep, linearised about whatever bias the preceding command left (a changed .param or the last DC-sweep point); a SPICE3 `.ac` needs its own arguments and always re-solves its own operating point
`.param rs=25.`: Gnucap re-assigns a parameter between analyses; a SPICE3 deck has one parameter value per run

`.ac`: bare Gnucap `.ac` repeats the previous sweep, linearised about whatever bias the preceding command left (a changed .param or the last DC-sweep point); a SPICE3 `.ac` needs its own arguments and always re-solves its own operating point
`.param rs= 100`: Gnucap re-assigns a parameter between analyses; a SPICE3 deck has one parameter value per run

`.ac`: bare Gnucap `.ac` repeats the previous sweep, linearised about whatever bias the preceding command left (a changed .param or the last DC-sweep point); a SPICE3 `.ac` needs its own arguments and always re-solves its own operating point

`.model pmos pmos level=7 vth0=-0.7`: Gnucap MOS level=7 is its own BSIM3v3 port; SPICE3/ngspice has no level 7, and substituting ngspice BSIM3 (level=8) is an unverified model change
